exposure_scope: same distinct training pairs; every full readout objective query reuses all pairs; not matched to GRU optimization budget

recipe.baseline: reuse audited core, original mixed and GRU readouts; no comparator training
recipe.correction: z=z0+h@W.T+b; bias arm omits W; zero correction reproduces actual z0
recipe.features: unscaled final head-input residuals, context ON; all original parameters frozen
recipe.independent_audit: all cached features/traces via fresh full-D selection; readout initial/final full-data autograd gradients and all fixed-cohort scores
recipe.numerical_gap_estimate: squared full gradient Euclidean norm/(2*lambda); not a formal roundoff-certified bound
recipe.objective: mean exact CE plus .001/2 times squared norm of ALL correction weights and biases
recipe.scope: richer-readout oracle with a larger optimization budget, not a parameter/exposure-matched architecture comparison
recipe.solver: SciPy L-BFGS-B from zero, analytic full-data gradient
recipe.solver_deadline_scope: checked before/after each data chunk and accepted callback; in-flight native calls covered by global watchdog
